correctness.rationale: Exact-walk geometric lemma proves the time-to-shadow equivalence; for fixed k,r the joint vacant-target probability depends on the union of distinct r-faces, and every overlapping tuple has strictly negative exponent v-ke/binom(k,r). Separate bounds exclude earlier and later times and the r=1 isolated-ground-point endpoint is proved without assuming target independence. 26,180 direct graph comparisons and independent exact two-target forbidden-neighborhood calculations support, but do not replace, the infinite proof.
